high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from Neil deGrasse Tyson on the X platform (formerly known as Twitter). The tweet contains a prophetic statement about the future impact of AI-generated deep-fakes on trust in news and social media. Tweet Content: The tweet reads: "PROPHESY: When AI perfects deep-fakes of people, places, & things, no news will be trusted. Even those who previously believed fake news will think their fake news is faked. At that moment a tear in the spacetime continuum will open and swallow all social media from the internet
